quality_tier_policy.note: quality_tier is a descriptive SRMSE label (doc 27 §7.2 thresholds below), not a release gate -- Bernardo ruled the release has no absolute SRMSE gate; the fail-closed structural gates (coverage, structural violations, child share, child exactness) decide whether a run is release-ready.

C.note: scored and published, below the A/B thresholds; every scored parish under 500 residents lands here at best, because the A/B population criteria are quality labels, not suppression

suppressed.note: publication_population below a POSITIVE --min-population (a draft sensitivity read); never at the release default 0 -- all parishes ship (Bernardo 2026-09-25, doc 201 §9.4)

unscored.note: no evaluation metrics supplied for this parish

accessibility_code.description: Dwelling accessible to a wheelchair user (PUF ACESSO): 1 yes, 2 no. Bound per parish to household_hh_accessibility_2021 (BGRI) and scored by the evaluator (srmse_h_accessibility). Null where hh_tenure_code is.

district.description: 2-digit district code (first two digits of freguesia). The Hive partition key: in the partitioned shards it is in the path only.

hh_rooms_bin.description: n_divisions at the grain INE/BGRI publish per parish: 1_2, 3_4, 5+.

hh_size.description: Number of residents (= the household's person rows).

hh_tenure_code.description: Tenure (regime de ocupação) in INE 12498's published vocabulary: 1 owner or co-owner, 3 tenant or sub-tenant, 4 other. The 2026-09-14 ruling's tenure_status_code, realised in INE's vocabulary (a bijective recode of the PUF's COND_OCUP, encoding.SEED_TENURE_TO_INE). Null outside habitual classical dwellings (0.16% of private households) and for institutional containers. Published but NOT fitted per parish in the shipping configuration (doc 203 §2 row 1: villages over-state renters).

hh_type_top.description: Household type by number of family nuclei: 1 none, 2 one, 3 two, 4 three or more. When the persons carry nucleus_id (A′) it is DERIVED at packaging from n_nuclei, so the household and its persons cannot disagree; otherwise it is the generated household head. Null for institutional containers.

is_institutional.description: 1 = a collective-dwelling container for the institutional residents appended after the fit from INE's published counts; 0 = a private household.

n_divisions.description: Rooms (divisões) of the dwelling, '1'..'10' where '10' = 10 or more. Same universe and null set as hh_tenure_code. Not fitted per parish in the shipping configuration (doc 203 §2 row 1).

n_nuclei.description: Number of distinct family nuclei (INE núcleo familiar) among the household's own persons, counted from nucleus_id at packaging. Null for institutional containers.

nuts2.description: NUTS II region code of residence.

residents_per_room.description: hh_size / n_divisions (with '10' read as 10). Null where n_divisions is.

synthetic_hh_id.description: Household id, unique only within a parish: join persons on (freguesia, synthetic_hh_id).

age.description: Age in completed years. Generated as a single year on A′ (D5); for appended institutional persons drawn inside the published 5-year band.

age_12grp.description: Age band of INE 12868 (marital universe); null under 12.

age_15grp.description: Age band of INE 12364/12880 ('Menos de 15 anos', ...).

age_5y.description: 5-year band of age; '90 ou mais anos' tops it.

age_group.description: '0 - 14 anos' if age < 15 else '15 e mais anos', derived from age at packaging (prepare_seed.py's definition).

age_union7.description: Age band of INE 12375 (union universe); null under 15.

district.description: 2-digit district code; the Hive partition key (path only in shards).

education_level.description: Portuguese label of education_level_code, regenerated from the code.

education_level_coarse5.description: Education in 5 levels, from the leaf code.

employment_status.description: Portuguese label of employment_status_code, regenerated from the code.

employment_status_coarse3.description: 11 employed, 12 unemployed, 2 inactive (from the leaf code).

income_source_code.description: Main source of livelihood (MEIOVIDA); null under 15.

industry_section.description: CAE Rev. 3 section of the activity, A..U with S split into S_94_96 / S_95; employed only. Generated; per-parish INE target employed_sex_industry.

is_institutional.description: 1 = institutional resident appended after the fit: sex and age from INE's published counts, education hot-decked, other attributes partial (CLAUDE.md THE UNIVERSE SPLIT).

nucleus_id.description: Family-nucleus membership inside the household: '0' = in no nucleus, '1'..'5' = the person's nucleus (a label, numbered by first appearance in age-descending member order; not a rank). Generated by the A′ nucleus head (doc 186). Known generator defect: INE's nucleus has at least two members, and some generated nuclei have one (doc 203 §2 row 7). It does NOT identify couples: the release carries no partner link (doc 204b §5).

occupation_code.description: CPP 2010 3-digit minor group; employed only. R9 Tier-1 derivation inside the generated occupation_major at INE 12306's per-parish x sex shares (else município, else national, by a size-matched null), rolling up to occupation_major exactly (scripts/v10_r9_occupation_industry_pass.py).

occupation_major.description: CPP 2010 major group (first digit of occupation_code); employed only. Generated; per-parish INE target employed_sex_occupation.

sex.description: H = Homem (male), M = Mulher (female). M is FEMALE.

synthetic_hh_id.description: The person's household: join on (freguesia, synthetic_hh_id).

transport_mode.description: Main means of transport to work or study (INE 12371 Dim5, '01'..'11'), or NR = travels, mode not reported; only for work_location_type 2-5. Generated.

union_de_facto.description: Lives in a de-facto union: Yes / No.

work_location_type.description: Place of work or study (INE 12369 Dim5): 1 at home, 2 this parish, 3 another parish of the município, 4 another município, 5 abroad, 6 no fixed place; employed and students only. Generated.
